01-jonas-stomach-sleeper-f1.hook: Jonas wakes up bent every single morning, and nobody has ever told him why.

02-jonas-bike-f1.hook: Jonas gets off his bike and walks into the office like he is still sitting in the saddle.

03-jonas-carpet-edge-f1.hook: Jonas trips over the same carpet edge in his own hallway every week, and nobody has ever told him why.

04-stairs-down-f3.hook: Walking down the stairs is harder on your legs than walking up. And that is not a sign of weakness.

05-back-not-glass-f3.hook: Your back is not made of glass. It is just being treated like it is one.

06-sitting-straight-f3.hook: Sitting perfectly straight is not the healthiest posture for your back. It is the most exhausting one.

07-back-sleeper-f2.hook: If you sleep on your back and feel it in your lower back every morning, listen for a second. I will explain three things right now that change that.

08-kneeling-f2.hook: If you build furniture on the weekend or kneel in the garden, listen for a second. I will explain three things right now that make the difference when you stand back up.

09-socks-f4.hook: Nobody ever explained putting on your socks to you.

10-breath-holding-f4.hook: Nobody ever explained to you why you hold your breath when you lift something heavy.

11-kids-no-back-pain-f5.hook: Kids almost never complain about back pain, and the reason isn't their age.

12-turning-at-night-f5.hook: You turn over about thirty times every night, and you don't remember a single one of them.
